purpose: Determine the full-video effect of the original earlier-feature points, using box-only automatic Lean with the same first YOLO box and pooled-grid memory.
selection: Previously inspected problem sequences and seq2 as a relatively strong reference; exploratory and outcome-selected.
method: Replay the old first automatic YOLO box and box-only provisional mask. Initialize Lean's mask-prompt anchor with that automatic mask; do not add any positive or negative points. Preserve all original model weights, memory score, frame order, precision and first-detection schedule. The saved combined original-points videos are the comparator.
constraints: No redetection, new adaptive gates or new decision thresholds. No labels or ground-truth prompts in inference. Existing YOLO settings and native binary-mask convention are unchanged.
verification: Two fresh-process seq3 full-video replays must match every saved original-points output and token selection; independently repeat a changed box-only seq2 video. The box-only mask must equal the old saved provisional prompt bit-for-bit. Independently rescore saved predictions against labels after each complete video.
metrics: All-frame present Dice and empty-frame false alarms plus matched historical target-frame Dice and native/Lean GT-prompt references. The prior native/Lean scores are not same-initialization controls. Report per-sequence outcomes and selected-cohort mean without population-generalization claims.
